scope: SfM-only seam graph and visibility-cell planner hardening; no SageMaker jobs launched for this proof.

root_cause.summary: The old CV-HR visibility-cell run produced overlap-dominated weak-core leaves that could pass old component/registration gates while failing strict seam graph scale checks.

implemented_patch.planner: visibility_cell_v1 now merges cells with fewer than COLMAP_VISIBILITY_CELL_MIN_CORE_IMAGES core cameras into the nearest viable neighbor before overlap assignment.
implemented_patch.fanout_contract: scripts/sfm/build_sfm_fanout_contract.py adds --min-core-images and blocks visibility_cell_v1 manifests with weak_core_chunks before launch.

verification.command: python3 -m py_compile infrastructure/containers/sfm/run_colmap_sfm.py scripts/sfm/build_sfm_fanout_contract.py scripts/sfm/run_sfm_reducer_canary.py scripts/sfm/run_sfm_fanout_reducer.py scripts/sfm/evaluate_sfm_quality.py
python3 -m unittest tests.unit.test_colmap_gps_priors tests.unit.test_sfm_reducer_canary tests.unit.test_sfm_fanout_contract tests.unit.test_sfm_fanout_reducer tests.unit.test_sfm_quality_eval

next_gate: Run a patched CV-HR planner/manifest replay with no-spend static gates. Only then launch the smallest paid CV-HR repair canary needed to prove seam_graph_sim3_v1 reconnects leaves 02/10 under scale gates.
